scenario: trapped inside an IKEA warehouse after closing time
part1_script: An IKEA warehouse has zero windows and forty automatic glass doors. The sensors open for anything moving toward them. At 9:15 PM, the store locked down automatically. You have 4,000 heavy wooden pallets and 12,000 gallons of water. Rule one is simple. Shut off all 500 showroom lamps before dark. Light attracts them through the clear glass entrance. You build a wall using eighty heavy BILLY bookcases. You fill every shelf with thick metal bed frames. At 2:14 in the morning, main power cuts out. The backup generator violently roars to life. Every light flashes back on. Fifty bodies slam the glass doors. The electronic lock snaps off. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
